title: Consulting for a jeans company on shading and stitching
summary: Don Hoffman tells of Consulting for a jeans company on shading and stitching, about an unknown time at an unknown place, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I remember the the the CEO, I won't mention the company, but the CEO of the company jumping out of his chair, going up to the screen and and and going, "Our jeans make my butt look bad."

plain: Don Hoffman, a scientist who studies how the brain builds what we see, says he once consulted for a jeans company, which he won't name, on how shading and stitching change the way the jeans look. He says the company's chief executive jumped out of his chair, went up to the screen and said their jeans made his backside look bad, a story he tells to show how much our perception is shaped by small tricks.
